text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOO...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Coming off the 4th corner, they'll soon enter the straight!
—Onto the straightaway, 400 meters to go...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —...Ngh, it hurts...!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(So this is the world—this is Dubai's pinnacle...!
And here I thought I understood...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (—I have to... surpass them... but...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: There's no way we're gonna loseee!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, NGHHH--!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—Even if I burn out right here... I don't care!
That's why—!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: To Japan—bring hope!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa!
Victoire Pisa wins it!
(UOOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Haah... *gasp*...

—A roar from the crowd so immense it seemed to pierce the sky.
—A fierce dash that felt as though they were burning up their very lives.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Staff A
text_block_list.text:
He did it, he did it, he did it...!!!
Pisa-san did it! He actually pulled it off!!

text_block_list.name: Local Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations, brother!
Tonight is the best night ever!"

text_block_list.name: Japanese Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Th-Thank you...?
Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Local Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "Let us deliver this joy back to Japan...!"

text_block_list.name: Media Representative A
text_block_list.text:
Camera, camera...! Capture everything!
The track, the stands—all of it—!

text_block_list.name: Media Representative A
text_block_list.text: Deliver it all, every last bit, to Japan!

Cheers of joy echoed all around,
exchanged in every conceivable language.

Race, nationality... winners and losers alike.
In that moment, that place transcended all barriers.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa has done it!
Chasing the dream, and making that dream come true, Victoire Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A victory where Victoire Pisa gives
courage and hope to Japan!
Rise again, Japan! Hang in there, Japan!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —The message! We have received it loud and clear all the way from Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
…………
...A circle... of smiles—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, ahh...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I... grasped it...!
The light...! Together as Team Japan—!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Reach them... back to Japan...!

Victoire Pisa—
holds the Hinomaru flag high in the air.
(THUD, THUD...!!)
Fireworks launched high into the sky, illuminating the fluttering national flag and the racetrack.

It was a bright, cheerful festival,
as if all the happiness in the world had been gathered together.

May this atmosphere full of joy
somehow reach that country across the sea.
—Yes, I couldn't help but pray.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No way...
...Did I really win?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Ah... if you're looking for water, I'm sorry. We're currently holding off on new stock for a while.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, um—
Where did you say the sports newspapers were?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Trending in Japan...
"Victoire Pisa Conquers Dubai"

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, talk about racing?
Haha, feels like it's been a while since we did that."

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently it's the first victory in history for a Japanese Umamusume."
"Victoire Pisa? Is that the girl who won the Arima Kinen too?"

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"A race at a time like this?"
"—No, it's *because* of times like this!"

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text: "I saw the video, it had such a happy vibe." "It was the first time in a while I saw Dad smiling, and it made me so happy."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, it's from Rose-san.
"Once again, congratulations, Pisa."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Your fierce run, and the incredible unity at the racetrack...
Honestly, it truly moved me."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"It seems the others felt the same way.
Every corner of the Academy is abuzz
with talk of your accomplishments."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I watched it countless times too.
I even watched it during breaks in training, which made Flash-senpai look at me in exasperation"...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I await your safe return.
See you back on the grounds."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...――
Thank goodness."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It seems what happened that day……
has been spreading as quite a positive topic.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Did I... manage to see it through to the end?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Was I able to form a circle once more—
and create a new, even if small, hope...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: On my own... it's just too—
As if the thread of tension had snapped, I catch Victoire Pisa as he collapses.

"She has truly accomplished a great cause—
putting her entire being into it, quite literally."
